Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!
…Snore…
Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?
…ZZZ…\nI…can't eat…anymore…
CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.

There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.
Did you check out the MUSEUM?
Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?
Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!
This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!
Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?
That's right!\nIt's hard work!
I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!
You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!
If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!
TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.
NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.
PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE
PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!
PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.
{PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.
{PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.
Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!
Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!
There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom
